Port on two organs: (a) water graph: a width-price budget line stamped per gated run by joining the fire ledger's existing fired_width column (memory/workflows/FIRE_LEDGER.jsonl tail row verified: fired_width 50, width_discrepancy true) to token burn in memory/runs/hermes_burn/usage.jsonl, prior = the Joshi 2x-at-4x point, the estate's own exponent to be measured never assumed, giving AGENTS.md:36's maintain-usefully clause its cost number; (b) context pack: the 0.5x-per-agent corollary makes width a context SPLITTER: per-child ask+packs may shrink toward half at width 4, stamped at the child-ask construction sites (.zcode/workflows/olm-mine.dwf.ts:143-148 areas config, :396-404 steal-round ask, verified first-hand) and adjudicated by the sibling card's G8 predicted-token check, priors marked as priors since the 0.5x is Ord's task family, not estate asks. (2) The Lazar collective model (quote byte-verified in _fx_sethlazar.json; sweep :183-196, thin pointer item, the 'here' link OWED): the gate enforces that a pass-off EXISTS (tools/workflow_gate.py:15) and WHERE it lives (placement law :86-108) but nothing measures whether the downstream actor holds a model of who holds what. Port: every pass-off ask carries (i) the upstream artifact pointer (path/hash) and (ii) a one-line who-holds-what roster, landed as a WARN-level soft row beside G2 under the gate's own soft-family precedent (:101-108: grep approximation by design, a false warn is a review conversation, not a blocked push); the receipt-xref gate (tools/receipt_xref_gate.py) already proves pointers resolve once they exist, this find makes them exist at the pass-off. Full write-up banked at watch/inbox/frontier_olm_2026-10-09/steal/swarm-orchestration via x.md with the same JSON appended per the 10-07 sibling convention.

Prior holdings honored: the Ord composed law and the SquidAgent test are the same-round arxiv sibling's bank, not re-banked; AGENTS.md:35/:36 are the base envelope, the pricing split is the only new byte; the G2 placement law already owns WHERE the feed lives, this card adds only WHO is modeled in it.
probe: The cite-vs-restate census over the estate's own pass-offs, offline, zero paid dispatch, corpus verified this session: memory/workflows/REGISTRY.jsonl carries 125 G2-passoff rows (grep -c), .zcode/workflows holds 20 scripts all carrying report() (grep -l | wc -l = 20 of 20), .zcode/workflow-drafts holds 94 more. Method: in each script with a G2 row, find the downstream ask that consumes an earlier actor's output; classify CITES (the ask interpolates a path/hash/report() pointer to the upstream artifact) vs RESTATES (the ask embeds a content copy with no pointer). PRE-REGISTERED before running: more than half CITES means Lazar's variable is already implicit in estate practice, the falsifier fires, and the soft G2 row is not drafted; half or fewer CITES means the collective model is a measured gap and the soft row gets drafted with the census as founding evidence. Cost: greps and reads over on-disk scripts, about one seat-hour. Companion calibration read for FIND 1 (not the probe): join FIRE_LEDGER fired_width rows to daily burn in usage.jsonl for a burn-per-width-point scatter; the Joshi prior predicts sublinear scaling (about 2x at 4x); named confound: heterogeneous tasks and no same-performance control offline, so calibration only, the real test needs the sibling card's forward G8 estimate data.
